messages:
Ravi: FYI our small-gpu tail latency spiked in us-west1b after the new packing rollout at 03:20. dozens of tiny inference pods Pending, then preempted.
Jo: any obvious scheduler errors in the events?
Ravi: root events show `FailedAttach` followed by `Preempted` for many pods. warmpool count went from ~140 -> 25 in ~15m.
Marta: I think the new packer is aggressively coalescing jobs by sequence buckets (opt for throughput). It looks like long-seq jobs pinned a subset of NVLink-rich nodes. small jobs starved the warm nodes and fell back to on-demand nodes where preemptions are higher.
infra-bot: ALERT: warm-pool depletion detected in us-west1b at 8460123600. impact: 48 small-gpu pods failed faststart attach.
Jo: can we isolate quickly? two possible mitigations: 1) revert packer change 2) temporarily increase warmpool.min in us-west1b + label small pods to prefer warmpool nodes.
Marta: revert will take ~8-12m rolling, but labeling admission mutator is faster and less disruptive. I can push a quick admission patch to add label `inference.size: small` for pods with `resources.limits.nvidia.com/gpu == 1 && metadata.annotations.seq_len < 1024`.
Ravi: also seeing elevated conntrack backlog on rack r12-14 which increases attach latency. that's why many pods miss warm attach window and are scheduled elsewhere then preempted.
SRE Oncall: immediate plan: Marta deploys admission mutator, infra bumps warmpool min to 160 for us-west1b, Jo watches preempt counts. If mutator not ready in 10m, we rollback packer.
Marta: deploying mutator now. patch: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: admission.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingWebhookConfiguration
...
EOF`
Jo: infra bumping warmpool: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1b -p '{"spec":{"minSize":160}}'`
infra-bot: ACTION: mutator rollout started at 8460123682. warmpool patch accepted at 8460123690.
Ravi: early metrics: pending queue dropping, small pod admissions resumed. nvlink error counts trending down. conntrack backlog still shows spikes on r12-14; network will remediate.
Marta: opened PR for packer to include spill-aware hedging (avoid packing >70% long-seq on NVLink racks). will also add a `seq_class` hint to the scheduler. PR: github.com/redwood/packers/pull/1123
SRE Oncall: follow-ups in ticket: 1) add tenant-level token-length skew metric; 2) add scheduler placement hint for seq_class; 3) consider per-rack conntrack autoscale or pod-attach backoff.
Jo: adding runbook entry: when warmpool < 30% baseline, set min to baseline+20% and notify infra/#oncall.
Ravi: thanks. keeping watch. will open postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
